pages.name: Scandinavian: Icelandic Gambit, 5.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 named White's d2-d4 in Black's plan; plans 1 and 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1-3 (reviewer: plan 2's 'blunt the e6-bishop' with d4 rejected once, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: Marshall, 4.c4 Nb6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed f4-f5 with the knight on f3 in the way; plan 3 called ...b5 a minority attack; the overview called the structure a Maroczy Bind. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: Marshall, 4.c4 Nb6 5.Nf3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 3 pushed an e4-pawn White doesn't have; plan 4 said the b6-knight controls c4, where White's pawn stands; plan 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: Marshall, 4.c4 Nb6 5.Nf3 g6 6.Be2 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the b6-knight via d7-f8-e6 and d7-c5, which knights can't do from b6; plan 1 suggested an f4 push with the knight on f3. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: Marshall, 4.c4 Nb6 5.Nf3 g6 6.h3 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted the b6-knight via c8, where the bishop stands; plans 1 and 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: Marshall, 4.c4 Nb6 5.Nf3 g6 6.Nc3 Bg7
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed an e4-pawn White doesn't have. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: Portuguese, 4.Bb5+
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...e6 and ...Be7 while Black is in check. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: Portuguese, 4.f3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed the g-pawn to g4 where Black's bishop stands and routed a knight Ne2-f4; plan 2 wrote the retreats without notation. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Alekhine Defence:Krejcik Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 used an f-file still closed by White's f2-pawn. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.
